purpose: Test whether the frame-1200 high-memory staging block is read directly during nearby renderer windows.
interpretation: Neither nearby 60-frame window read the sampled 0xFFF982F0-0xFFF98760 block through the traced GSP program space. The block is therefore not promoted as a directly consumed indexed-record source for these windows. This is a bounded negative result, not proof that the block is never read or that its values have no rendering role.
